title: The board and the pieces
line: Where each piece starts, a light square in the right corner, the queen on her own color.

steps.text: A chessboard has 64 squares, light and dark. Each player has 16 pieces: White starts at the bottom, Black at the top.
Each player has a light square in the corner on their right. Tap the light corner square on White's side.

wrong.a1: That corner is dark. The light one is on White's right.
wrong.a8: That corner is on Black's side.
wrong.h8: That corner is on Black's side.

steps.after: If a board is set up turned around, this square shows it.

steps.text: Each square has a name: a letter for its column, a to h, and a number for its row, 1 to 8. The light corner is h1.
The rooks stand in the corners. Next to them are the knights, then the bishops.
The queen starts on a square of her own color. Tap the white queen.

wrong.e1: That is the king. The queen stands beside him, on his left.
wrong.d8: That is the black queen. Tap the white one.

steps.after: The white queen starts on a light square, the black queen on a dark one.

steps.text: The king takes the last square in the middle of the row. Tap the black king.

wrong.d8: That is the black queen. The king stands beside her.
wrong.e1: That is the white king. Tap the black one.

steps.after: The kings face each other across the board.

steps.text: The pawns fill the row in front of the pieces. Tap a white pawn.
steps.after: Each side has eight pawns, one in front of each piece.

steps.text: White always moves first. Then the players take turns, one move each.

summary: Rooks in the corners, then knights and bishops, the queen on her own color. White moves first.
